Hi Asha / Tom — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same MAP baseline. I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (Heathaven_MAP_v0.2.xlsx).

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Primary use case: clinical summarization and patient care insights for case managers.
- Key success metrics: 50% reduction in triage time, under 400ms 95th token latency for API calls.
- Data requirements: PHI scanning, no long-term storage of unredacted PHI in hosted mode unless approved.

Draft MAP highlights (owners + target dates)
1) Procurement review & legal redlines — Owner: Tom Ruiz (Heathaven) — Target: 2027-06-28
2) Security questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence — Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) / Procurement — Target: 2027-06-21
3) Pilot environment (dev data only, private deployment) — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) — Target: 2027-07-05
4) Pilot evaluation & success metrics sign-off — Owner: Asha Patel (Heathaven) — Target: 2027-07-12
5) Production go-live & contract signature — Owner: Tom Ruiz (Heathaven) / Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood) — Target: 2027-07-15 (proposed close date)

Dependencies and open items
- Procurement needs SOC 2 sample artifacts (Neha, I can send the bundle this week).
- Integration support: Redwood dedicated capacity will be provisioned for the pilot; we need IP allowlist entries from your network team.
- Budget approval: Tom, can you confirm spend owner and any internal PO timelines?

Action items (who does what by when)
- Asha: confirm procurement PO owner and internal sign-off cadence (by 2027-06-03)
- Tom: review MAP and flag any changes to milestones/owners (by 2027-06-07)
- Neha: share SOC 2 excerpts and compliance checklist (by 2027-06-04)
- Ben: prepare pilot runbook and estimate of token cost for pilot (by 2027-06-07)

If no major objections, we'll consider the attached v0.2 as the working MAP and issue a weekly checkpoint email every Friday with updates. I've put a proposed quick cadence: 15-minute sync next week if procurement wants a walkthrough.
